verdict.rationale: Automation API lets you embed the Pulumi engine as an SDK and build software that creates, updates, and destroys infrastructure without the CLI, so autonomous runs are possible if you host and trigger that code yourself. Neo is marketed as handling dependencies, executing changes, and monitoring outcomes automatically, and the MCP server can delegate tasks to Neo. The evidence for agentic background operation is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documented background or scheduled execution (cron, triggers, drift-detection jobs), a managed runtime for unattended automations, detail on how Neo runs tasks autonomously, and independent hands-on corroboration.
